scope: Private manual media annotation session invalidation and canonical reload
implemented: After successful annotation storage or deletion, MediaLabelService broadcasts media_label_changed only to the authenticated owner's connections. Failed storage does not broadcast. Events carry source references, not label values or decrypted content.

Mounted annotation consumers subscribe to bounded-lifetime owner/source invalidations. No persistent label cache or unbounded message history is retained. Events for another account, malformed references, unsubscribed consumers and old authentication generations are ignored.

Invalidation immediately aborts in-flight responses, revokes temporary visibility and matching detached viewers, returns the media to unknown preferences and re-reads canonical server state. Delayed events cannot directly restore a stale revealing label.

Successful HTTP mutations invalidate other mounted copies even without the originating socket echo. Every ready/reconnect handshake invalidates the current owner's mounted labels to recover events missed while offline.
Async annotation reads and writes also verify the encryption device identity before applying a result. Clearing/replacing the device invalidates an old receipt.

verification.detail: Includes owner-only event routing after storage, no public/server/multiple-owner broadcast, no label value in payload, and no invalidation on failed set/delete.
